target: Buah jatuh tak jauh dari pohonnya; anak itu rajin persis seperti ibunya.
english: The fruit doesn't fall far from its tree; that child is diligent exactly like her mother.
tip: Buah jatuh tak jauh dari pohonnya – the fruit doesn't fall far from its tree: children take after their parents. Same image as 'a chip off the old block'.
